hero.title: From business bottlenecks to intelligent automation.
hero.intro: I help businesses turn repetitive processes, fragmented systems and operational inefficiencies into practical AI-powered workflows, scoped around a defined deliverable rather than open-ended hours.
hero.honesty: I haven't delivered a paid client project yet. What I can show is the engineering: the case studies on this site, with their architecture, tests and limits written down.

services.title: AI workflow automation
services.problem: Routine items (emails, requests, forms, reports) are read, sorted and answered by hand.
services.solution: An LLM pipeline that classifies, summarises and drafts, with clear rules for what a person must still approve.
services.example: New enquiry arrives → labelled by urgency and intent → draft reply prepared → urgent items routed to a person.
services.benefit: Fewer hours on routine handling; urgent items still reviewed by a person.

services.title: RAG and knowledge systems
services.problem: Answers are spread across documents, past messages and websites, and people search by hand.
services.solution: Retrieval that puts the relevant sources in front of the model, with citations people can check.
services.example: Question → search and retrieve sources → answer with links → saved to the conversation.
services.benefit: Faster answers that can be checked against their sources.

services.title: Custom AI agents
services.problem: Research, comparison and monitoring tasks need several tools and steps, not one prompt.
services.solution: An agent with typed tools, caching, provider fallbacks and visible progress.
services.example: Research request → agent plans → calls search, reader and data tools → returns a structured answer.
services.benefit: Multi-step lookups done in minutes, with the working shown.

services.title: Data and system integration
services.problem: Data lives in spreadsheets and disconnected tools, in inconsistent formats.
services.solution: Pipelines and APIs that clean, validate and connect the data, flagging bad records instead of hiding them.
services.example: Monthly spreadsheet export → parsed and profiled → quality issues flagged → KPIs computed → report.
services.benefit: One trusted view of the numbers and a clear list of data problems.

services.title: AI technical discovery and architecture
services.problem: You think AI could help but don't know where, what it would cost, or what could go wrong.
services.solution: A short assessment of the workflow, the data and the options, ending in a written architecture and plan.
services.example: Walk through the workflow → identify the bottleneck → compare approaches → architecture and roadmap.
services.benefit: A clear yes, no or not-yet before any money goes into building.
